item.title: Jeong Jeom-sik: "Abolishing supplementary investigative powers will lead to the simultaneous collapse of both the government and ruling party" (정점식 “보완수사권 폐지하면 정부·여당 동반 몰락할 것”)
item.description:
Jeong Jeom-sik: "Abolishing supplementary investigative powers will lead to the simultaneous collapse of both the government and ruling party" (정점식 “보완수사권 폐지하면 정부·여당 동반 몰락할 것”)

On the 26th, Jeong Jeom-sik, floor leader of the People Power Party, criticized the Democratic Party's push to abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigative powers, saying, "The president and the ruling party are putting the lives and safety of the people on the scale of political engineering and engaging in a despicable bargaining." (국민의힘 정점식 원내대표는 26일 더불어민주당의 검찰 보완수사권 폐지 추진에 대해 “대통령과 여당이 국민의 생명과 안전을 정치공학의 저울 위에 올려놓고, 추악한 흥정을 하고 있다”고 비판했다.)

On Facebook that day, Floor Leader Chung said, "The entire nation is watching your ugly deal closely. He said, "If the abolition of supplementary investigative powers passes a plenary vote and the president even gives up the right to request reconsideration, from that very moment, both the government and the ruling party will collapse together." (정 원내대표는 이날 페이스북에서 “온 국민이 당신들의 추악한 거래를 똑똑히 지켜보고 있다. 반드시 심판받을 것”이라며 “만약 보완수사권 폐지가 본회의 표결을 통과하고 대통령이 재의요구권마저 포기한다면, 바로 그 순간부터 정부와 여당은 동반 몰락”이라고 했다.)

Floor Leader Jung pointed out that President Lee Jae-myung is remaining silent on the controversy over abolishing supplementary investigation powers, saying, "From the president's perspective, openly advocating for the abolition of supplementary investigation powers would cause a future crime crisis and public backlash," adding, "But insisting on retaining supplementary investigation powers will cause the Democratic Party's hardliners and the behind-the-scenes dealings to withdraw indictments might break down." (정 원내대표는 이재명 대통령이 보완수사권 폐지 논란에 침묵하고 있다고 지적하면서 “대통령 입장에선 대놓고 보완수사권 폐지를 주장하자니 앞으로 일어날 범죄 대란과 여론의 역풍이 두려울 것”이라며 “그렇다고 보완수사권 존치를 주장하자니, 민주당 강경파와 공소취소 뒷거래가 깨질까 봐 걱정될 것”이라고 했다.)

He continued, "A president of a country shirks political responsibility for atrocities that shake the foundation of the rule of law," and "He only thinks about his own security after leaving office. Should politics be made so cowardly?" (이어 “일국의 대통령이 법치주의의 근간을 뒤흔드는 만행에 대해 정치적 책임을 회피한다”며 “오직 퇴임 이후 본인의 안전 보장만 염두에 두고 있다. 정치를 이렇게 비겁하게 해서야 되겠느냐”고 했다.)

Choi Bo-yoon, chief spokesperson for the People Power Party, also said in a statement that day, "The Democratic Party's public hearings and caucus were merely formalities, and the desperate voices of crime victims were drowned out under pressure from hardline fandoms," adding, "The Democratic Party's legislative rampage, which prioritizes the favor of hardline supporters over public safety, cannot be justified under any justification." (국민의힘 최보윤 수석대변인도 이날 논평에서 “민주당의 공청회와 의원총회는 요식행위에 그쳤고, 범죄 피해자들의 절박한 목소리는 강성 팬덤의 압박 속에 묻혀버렸다”며 “국민의 안전보다 강성 지지층의 환심을 앞세운 민주당의 입법 폭주는 어떠한 명분으로도 정당화될 수 없다”고 했다.)

Spokesperson Choi said, "What is most lamentable is the attitude of President Lee Jae-myung, who is ultimately responsible for state affairs," adding, "Instead of controlling the ruling party's hardline faction's extreme legislative rampage, they merely watch the hardline party members' reactions and watch the judicial system collapse." He continued, "The president's helpless indifference combined with the arrogance of the ruling party's hardliners is paralyzing South Korea's criminal justice system." (최 대변인은 “무엇보다 개탄스러운 것은 국정의 최종 책임자인 이재명 대통령의 태도”라며 “여당 강경파의 극단적인 입법 폭주를 제어하기는커녕, 강성 당원들의 눈치만 살피며 사법 체계가 무너지는 과정을 방관하고 있다”고 했다. 그러면서 “대통령의 무기력한 방관과 여당 강경파의 오만이 결합해 대한민국 형사사법 시스템을 마비시키고 있는 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Ruling party Legislation and Judiciary Committee chair: "The Choi Young-jung case is the prosecution-ruling Jang Yoon-gi case" (與 법사위원장 “최영중 사건은 검찰판 장윤기 사건”)
item.description:
Ruling party Legislation and Judiciary Committee chair: "The Choi Young-jung case is the prosecution-ruling Jang Yoon-gi case" (與 법사위원장 “최영중 사건은 검찰판 장윤기 사건”)

Seo Young-kyo, chairman of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee from the Democratic Party, said on the 26th regarding the child prostitution allegations involving former Cheongju City Council member Choi Young-joong, "This could become a prosecutor-case case of Jang Yoon-gi." (더불어민주당 소속 서영교 국회 법제사법위원장은 26일 최영중 전 청주시의원의 아동 성매매 의혹과 관련해 “검찰판 장윤기 사건이 될 수 있다”고 말했다.)

Amid growing public opposition to the abolition of supplementary investigative powers following the 'Jang Yoon-gi case,' which is suspected of police concealing and downplaying the case, Chairman Seo defined this case as the 'prosecution-style Jang Yoon-gi case' and insisted that abolishing supplementary investigative powers is absolutely necessary. (경찰이 사건을 은폐·축소했다는 의혹을 받는 ‘장윤기 사건’을 계기로 보완수사권 폐지 반대 여론이 커지는 상황에서, 서 위원장은 이번 사건을 ‘검찰판 장윤기 사건’으로 규정하며 보완수사권 폐지가 반드시 필요하다고 맞선 것이다.)

On this day, Chairman Seo held a press conference at the National Assembly titled 'Obstruction of Prosecutorial Investigation and Current Issues of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee,' stating, "(The Choi Young-jung case) could become the case of Jang Yoon-gi in the prosecution," and added, "Both the police and prosecutors should not be concerned about the opinions of People Power Party city council members or metropolitan committee chairs, but must conduct a thorough investigation and request an arrest warrant." (서 위원장은 이날 국회에서 ‘검찰 수사방해 및 법사위 현안 관련 기자회견’을 열고 “(최영중 사건은) 검찰판 장윤기 사건이 될 수 있다”며 “경찰도 검찰도 국민의힘 시의원이나 광역위원장 눈치를 보지 말고 철저히 수사해 구속영장을 청구해야 한다”고 했다.)

He continued, "The 13-year-old victim was abandoned by prosecutors who protect power through lies," and "This is a case in which a 13-year-old child was sexually exploited. According to common sense, the prosecution should have investigated this from the victim's side." (이어 “거짓말로 권력을 지키는 검찰에 의해 13세 피해자는 버려졌다”며 “13세 아이가 성착취를 당한 사건이다. 국민 상식으로는 검찰이 피해자 편에서 수사했어야 할 사안”이라고 했다.)

Kim Seung-won, the Democratic Party's committee secretary, also said, "The prosecution's supplementary investigations have always been selective," and added, "In this case as well, the prosecution requested supplementary investigations such as vehicle inspections when applying for a search and seizure warrant. The prosecution's supplementary investigation was not a tool for the truth, but a weapon to be used selectively." (민주당 법사위 간사인 김승원 의원도 “검찰의 보완수사는 언제나 선택적이었다”며 “이 사건에서도 검찰은 압수수색 영장을 신청하면서 차량 조회를 요구하는 등 보완수사를 요구했다. 검찰의 보완수사는 진실을 위한 도구가 아니라 골라 쓰는 무기였다”고 주장했다.)

Meanwhile, regarding reports that Justice Minister Jeong Seong-ho expressed his intention to resign while the Democratic Party is pushing for a bill to abolish supplementary investigative powers of the prosecution, Chairman Seo said, "I have not heard the word 'resignation,'" and added, "I understand that he said he would come to the National Assembly. In my view, as Minister of Justice, there is much work to do." (한편 서 위원장은 검찰 보완수사권 폐지 법안을 민주당이 추진하는 가운데 정성호 법무부 장관이 사의를 표명했다는 보도에 대해선 “사의라는 말은 듣지 못했다”며 “‘국회에 오겠다’고 한 것으로 안다. 제가 보기에는 법무부 장관으로서 하셔야 할 일이 많다”고 일축했다.)

item.title: ARF Chairman's Statement Mentions "Complete Denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula" for the Second Year in Row (ARF 의장성명, 2년 연속 “한반도의 완전한 비핵화” 언급)
item.description:
ARF Chairman's Statement Mentions "Complete Denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula" for the Second Year in Row (ARF 의장성명, 2년 연속 “한반도의 완전한 비핵화” 언급)

Foreign ministers from the Indo-Pacific region adopted a statement from the chair of the ASEAN Regional Security Forum (ARF), expressing concern over North Korea's nuclear and missile programs, urging denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula, and emphasizing dialogue among the parties. (인도·태평양 지역 외교장관들이 북한의 핵·미사일 프로그램을 우려하면서 한반도 비핵화를 촉구하고 당사국 간 대화를 강조하는 내용의 아세안지역안보포럼(ARF) 의장 성명을 채택했다.)

According to diplomatic sources on the 26th, the chairman's statement from the ARF meeting, released the previous day, said, "This meeting expressed concern over recent developments on the Korean Peninsula and emphasized the importance of resuming peaceful dialogue among all relevant parties to achieve lasting peace and stability in a denuclearized peninsula." This ARF meeting was attended by delegations from major Indo-Pacific countries including Korea, the United States, Japan, China, and Russia. (26일 외교가에 따르면, 전날 공개된 ARF 회의 의장 성명은 “본 회의는 최근 한반도 상황 전개에 대해 우려를 표명하고, 비핵화된 한반도에서 항구적인 평화와 안정을 실현하기 위해 모든 관련 당사국 간 평화적 대화를 재개하는 것의 중요성을 강조했다”고 밝혔다. 이번 ARF 회의엔 한국을 비롯해 미국, 일본, 중국, 러시아 등 주요 인태 지역 국가의 대표단이 참가했다.)

He continued, "This meeting expressed serious concern that North Korea's ongoing development of nuclear weapons and ballistic missile programs, which violates UN Security Council resolutions, is a troubling situation threatening regional peace and stability." (이어 “본 회의는 유엔 안보리 관련 결의를 위반한 조선민주주의인민공화국의 지속적인 핵무기 및 탄도미사일 프로그램 개발이 지역의 평화와 안정을 위협하는 우려스러운 상황 전개라는 점에 대해 심각한 우려를 표명했다”고 했다.)

He continued, "This meeting called for the full implementation of all relevant UN Security Council resolutions and highlighted the international community's efforts to promote complete denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula through peaceful means." (그러면서 “본 회의는 모든 관련 유엔 안보리 결의의 완전한 이행을 촉구했으며, 평화적 방식으로 한반도의 완전한 비핵화를 도모하기 위한 국제사회의 노력을 주목했다”고 했다.)

He continued, "Diplomatic efforts, including creating a favorable environment for peaceful dialogue among all relevant parties, must remain a top priority," and reaffirmed, "This meeting reaffirmed its readiness to play a constructive role in fostering a favorable atmosphere for peaceful dialogue among relevant parties through the use of ASEAN-led platforms like the ARF." (이어 “모든 관련 당사국 간 평화적 대화를 위한 유리한 환경 조성을 포함한 외교적 노력이 최우선 과제로 유지되어야 한다”며 “본 회의는 관련 당사국 간 평화적 대화를 위한 유리한 분위기를 조성하는 데 ARF와 같은 아세안 주도 플랫폼 활용 등을 통해 건설적인 역할을 수행할 준비가 되어 있음을 재확인했다”고 했다.)

The ARF chairperson's statement showed a different tone from the past, starting last year when North Korea first abstained. (ARF 의장 성명은 북한이 처음 불참한 작년을 기점으로 과거와는 달라진 기조를 보였다.)

Until 2024, the term 'CVID' (complete, verifiable, and irrevocable denuclearization) was used for three consecutive years regarding North Korea's nuclear issue, but since last year, this term has been changed to 'complete denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula.' (2024년까지는 북핵과 관련해 3년 연속 ‘CVID’(완전하고 검증 가능하며 되돌릴 수 없는 비핵화)라는 표현을 썼으나, 지난해부터 이 표현이 ‘한반도의 완전한 비핵화’로 바뀌었다.)

CVID is a term North Korea has long opposed. The inclusion of a lower level of 'complete denuclearization' this time is interpreted as reflecting our government's policy direction to keep dialogue channels open with North Korea. However, North Korea did not attend the ARF meeting again this year, following last year. (CVID는 북한이 그동안 반발해 온 표현이다. 이번에 그보다 낮은 수위의 ‘완전한 비핵화’가 들어간 것은 북한과의 대화 채널을 열어놓겠다는 우리 정부의 정책 방향이 반영된 것으로 해석된다. 다만 북한은 작년에 이어 올해도 ARF 회의에 불참했다.)

Regarding dialogue with North Korea, while 'continuing dialogue' was mentioned in 2024, last year and this year the term was changed to 'resume dialogue,' reflecting the current situation where communication between the two Koreas has effectively been suspended. (대북 대화와 관련해선 2024년 ‘대화 지속’이 언급된 반면, 지난해와 올해는 ‘대화 재개’라는 표현으로 바뀌어 남북 간 소통이 사실상 중단된 현 상황을 반영했다.)

The statement said regarding the situation in the South China Sea, "We expect to continue efforts within this year to conclude effective and substantive Code of Conduct (COC) negotiations in line with the 1982 United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS)." He added, "This meeting emphasized the importance of restraint in all activities by claimant states and all other countries, which could further complicate the situation in the South China Sea and escalate tensions." (성명은 남중국해 상황에 대해서 “1982년 유엔해양법협약(UNCLOS)에 부합하는 효과적이고 실질적인 행동강령(COC) 협상을 올해 내에 타결하기 위해 지속해 노력하기를 기대했다”고 했다. 그러면서 “본 회의는 남중국해의 상황을 더욱 복잡하게 만들고 긴장을 고조시킬 수 있는 영유권 주장국 및 다른 모든 국가의 모든 활동 수행에 있어 자제의 중요성을 강조했다”고 했다.)

Regarding the situation in the Middle East, he expressed "serious concern over the rapidly changing situation in the region, especially the renewed hostilities between the United States and Iran," and said, "We support diplomatic efforts to bring lasting and lasting peace to the Middle East." (중동 상황을 두고는 “중동 지역에서 급변하는 상황, 특히 미국과 이란 간의 재개된 적대 행위에 대해 심각한 우려”를 표명하면서 “중동에 지속적이고 항구적인 평화를 가져오기 위한 외교적 노력을 지지한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok: "An anti-Ming pro-Cheung party is unacceptable"... Jung Cheong-rae: "I am the one who will protect the president" (김민석 “반명 친청 당 안될 일”... 정청래 “대통령 지킬 사람은 나”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok: "An anti-Ming pro-Cheung party is unacceptable"... Jung Cheong-rae: "I am the one who will protect the president" (김민석 “반명 친청 당 안될 일”... 정청래 “대통령 지킬 사람은 나”)

Democratic Party candidates Kim Min-seok, Jung Cheong-rae, and Song Young-gil, who are running for party leader, engaged in sharp battles over the weekend of the 26th. Kim and Chung exchanged attacks over 'anti-Myeong' and 'Shincheonji allegations,' while Song indirectly criticized Jeong. (더불어민주당 당대표 선거에 나선 김민석·정청래·송영길 후보가 주말인 26일에도 날선 공방을 벌였다. 김 후보와 정 후보는 ‘반명’ ‘신천지 의혹’으로 공격을 주고 받았고, 송 후보는 정 후보를 우회 비판했다.)

At a lecture held at the Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology that day, Kim spoke about the pro-Cheong (pro-government, Cheong-lae) candidates for Supreme Council members—Choi Min-hee, Han Min-soo, and Lee Sung-yoon—"I call them anti-Lee Jae-myung pro-Cheong candidates, but do you think the Democratic Party is a party that can send three anti-Lee candidates to Supreme Council members?" He added, "The key point is whether the pro-Lee candidates will be defeated by four to one pro-Blue candidates, and whether they will ultimately defeat all the pro-Cheong candidates and go to 5 to 0." (김 후보는 이날 광주과학기술원에서 열린 초청강연회에서 친청(친정청래)계 최민희, 한민수, 이성윤 최고위원 후보들에 대해 “저는 반명(반이재명) 친청 후보라고 부르는데, 민주당이 반명 후보를 3명이나 최고위원 시킬 당이라고 생각하는가”라며 “(친명)4대 (친청)1의 판세가 형성되고, 마지막에 (친청 후보를) 몽땅 떨어뜨리고 5대 0으로 가느냐가 관전 포인트”라고 했다.)

The lecture was attended by candidates for Supreme Council members classified as pro-Lee faction, such as Kim Yong, Seo Mi-hwa, Park Sun-won, and Im Mi-ae. (이날 강연에는 김용, 서미화, 박선원, 임미애 등 친명계로 분류되는 최고위원 후보들이 참석했다.)

Candidate Jung attended a party member meeting held at the Ulsan City Party. He said, "I am confident that the person who will protect President Lee to the end will be Jeong Cheong-rae, who has never betrayed the party or left the party," and added, "I will protect the President and the Democratic Party, so please protect Jeong Cheong-rae yourself." (정 후보는 울산시당에서 열린 당원간담회에 참석했다. 그는 “이 대통령을 끝까지 지킬 사람은 당을 한 번도 배신한 적 없고 탈당한 적 없는 정청래가 될 것이라고 확신한다”며 “대통령과 민주당은 내가 지킬 테니 여러분이 정청래를 지켜달라”고 했다.)

Previously, on his Facebook, he targeted candidate Kim for raising the Shincheonji allegations, saying, "The convention will likely become a negative event that undermines the Shincheonji controversy," and added, "Those who threw the party into chaos should apologize to their members, and the party should take strict action." (앞서 자신의 페이스북에는 신천지 의혹 제기한 김 후보 겨냥해 “전당대회가 신천지 논란으로 제살깎아먹기식 마이너스 대회가 될 것 같다”며 “당을 혼란 속으로 몰아넣은 당사자는 당원들에게 사과하고, 당은 엄중히 조치해주기를 바란다”고 했다.)

Song, who has been campaigning in Jeonbuk for three days, targeted Jeong, saying, "It's been a little over a year since the Lee Jae-myung administration took office, and Jeong Cheong-rae has run the party. What do you think about the relationship between the party and the Blue House?" (사흘째 전북에서 선거운동 중인 송 후보는 “이재명 정부 출범 1년이 조금 지났고, 정청래 후보가 당을 운영했는데 당·청 관계가 어땠던 것 같냐”며 정 후보를 겨냥했다.)

He then posted on his Facebook, "Will we complete reforms while protecting the president? Will he fall into the dogma of reform, shake the president, and fail even in reform?" He also said, "Reforms that shake the president and only shout slogans may receive applause from certain politicians, but they end in defeat in the general election and a change of government." (그러면서 자신의 페이스북에 “대통령을 지키며 개혁을 완성할 것인가? 개혁의 도그마에 빠져 대통령을 흔들다 개혁까지 실패할 것인가”라고 썼다. 또 “대통령을 흔들며 구호만 외치는 개혁은 특정 정치인들이 박수는 받을지 몰라도 총선 패배와 정권교체로 끝난다”고도 했다.)

item.title: 'Floor leader by the collar' Kwon Young-jin... People Power Party: "We must decide our own position" (‘원내대표 멱살’ 권영진에…국힘 “스스로 거취 정해야”)
item.description:
'Floor leader by the collar' Kwon Young-jin... People Power Party: "We must decide our own position" (‘원내대표 멱살’ 권영진에…국힘 “스스로 거취 정해야”)

On the 26th, the People Power Party floor leadership protested the recent assignment of standing committees in the National Assembly and said on the 26th about Representative Kwon Young-jin, who grabbed floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik by the collar, "I think it is right for him to decide his own position." (국민의힘 원내지도부가 최근 국회 상임위원회 배정 결과에 항의하며 정점식 원내대표의 멱살을 잡은 권영진 의원에 대해 26일 “본인 스스로가 거취를 정하는 것이 맞지 않나 싶다”고 했다.)

Choi Soo-jin, the chief spokesperson for the Assembly, met with reporters at the National Assembly that day and responded to questions about party-level measures against Kwon, saying, "Kwon Young-jin grabbing (Floor Leader Jung) by the collar is, in the end, equivalent to violence," making this statement. (최수진 원내수석대변인은 이날 국회에서 기자들과 만나 권 의원에 대한 당 차원의 조치와 관련한 질문에 대해 “권영진 의원이 (정 원내대표) 멱살을 잡은 일은 결국 폭력과 같다”며 이처럼 밝혔다.)

Spokesperson Choi said, "The lawmakers believe that strong measures must be taken to prevent recurrence." He said, "Grabbing a former and current floor leader by the collar is something that cannot happen within the party, regardless of the reason," and added, "I deeply regret it. I think it's time to focus more quickly on fighting the Democratic Party." (최 대변인은 “재발 방지를 위해서라도 강력히 조치해야 한다는 것이 의원님들의 생각”이라고 말했다. 그는 “전·현직 원내대표의 멱살을 잡은 건 어떤 이유를 불문하고 당에서 일어날 수 없는 일”이라며 “심각히 유감을 표시하는 바다. 빨리 민주당과 싸우는 데에 더 집중해야 될 때라고 생각한다”고 했다.)

Previously, on the 23rd, Kwon, dissatisfied with the assignment of standing committees for the latter half of the National Assembly, approached Floor Leader Jeong by the collar and got into a physical altercation with Representative Song Eon-seok (former floor leader), who tried to stop him. Although Kwon was assigned as a secretary of the Public Administration and Security Committee, it is known that he himself wanted to serve as secretary of the Intelligence Committee, which is frequently exposed to the media. (앞서 권 의원은 지난 23일 국회 후반기 상임위원회 배정에 불만을 품고 정 원내대표를 찾아가 멱살을 잡고, 이 과정에서 말리는 송언석 의원(전 원내대표)과도 몸싸움을 벌였다. 권 의원은 행안위 간사로 배치됐으나 본인은 언론에 자주 노출되는 정보위원회 간사를 원한 것으로 알려졌다.)

As the controversy grew, Kwon posted an apology in the Telegram group chat room. He stepped down from his position as secretary of the Public Administration and Security Committee and the previously nominated position as the next chairman of the People Power Party's Daegu City Chapter. (논란이 커지자 권 의원은 텔레그램 의원 단체 대화방에 사과문을 올렸다. 그는 행안위 간사직과 함께 내정돼 있던 차기 국민의힘 대구시당 위원장직도 내려놨다.)

The disciplinary action and future of Kwon are expected to be decided at the general assembly of lawmakers scheduled for next week. Earlier, the People Power Party's floor leadership group issued a statement demanding a public apology from Kwon and accountability according to proper procedures. (권 의원에 대한 징계 및 거취 문제는 다음 주 소집 예정인 의원총회에서 결정될 전망이다. 앞서 국민의힘 원내부대표단은 성명을 내고 권 의원의 공개 사과 및 합당한 절차에 따른 책임을 요구했다.)

item.title: "Russia wants additional 30,000 North Korean troops deployed" (“러, 북한군 3만명 추가 파병 원한다”)
item.description:
"Russia wants additional 30,000 North Korean troops deployed" (“러, 북한군 3만명 추가 파병 원한다”)

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said on the 25th (local time) that Russia wants to receive an additional 30,000 troops from North Korea, and Russia is preparing to deploy the additional North Korean soldiers to border areas. (볼로디미르 젤렌스키 우크라이나 대통령이 25일(현지 시각) 러시아가 북한으로부터 병력 3만명을 추가로 파견받기를 원하고 있으며, 러시아는 추가 파병되는 북한군을 접경지에 배치하는 방안을 준비하고 있다고 밝혔다.)

President Zelensky stated in a speech posted on social media that day, "Russia wants North Korea to send an additional 30,000 troops," adding, "Preparations to accommodate them in Russia's Voronezh region have been underway since June." Voronezh, located in southwestern Russia, shares a border with Ukraine. (젤렌스키 대통령은 이날 소셜미디어에 올린 연설문에서 “러시아는 북한이 3만명을 추가 파병해 주길 원한다”며 “6월부터 러시아 보로네시 지역에 이들을 수용하기 위한 준비가 진행되고 있다”고 밝혔다. 러시아 남서부에 있는 보로네시는 우크라이나와 국경을 맞대고 있다.)

President Zelensky also said, "North Korea is preparing to deploy additional ballistic missile launchers to Russia," and that "This is not only a threat to Ukraine." He added, "Russia is helping North Korea learn how to wage war, improve its weapons, and gain combat experience," noting, "All of this threatens Asian countries within the range of North Korean missiles." (젤렌스키 대통령은 또 “북한이 추가 탄도미사일 발사대를 러시아에 배치하려고 준비하고 있다”며 “이것은 우크라이나에만 위협이 되는 것이 아니다”라고 했다. 그러면서 “러시아는 북한이 어떻게 전쟁을 수행하는지 배우고 무기를 개량하며 실전 경험을 쌓는 것을 돕고 있다”며 “이 모든 것이 북한 미사일의 사정거리에 있는 아시아 각국에 위협이 된다”고 덧붙였다.)

Earlier this month, Ukraine's Defense Intelligence Agency (HUR) reported that North Korea supplies up to 40% of the artillery shells used by Russian forces. It also stated that since June 2023, North Korea has provided Russia with about 100 short-range ballistic missiles—KN-23 and KN-24—and mobile launchers, and that the accuracy of North Korean missiles has improved as the war has dragged on. (앞서 이달 초 우크라이나 군사정보국(HUR)은 러시아군이 사용하는 포탄의 최대 40%를 북한이 지원하고 있다고 밝혔다. 또 지난 2023년 6월 이후 북한이 러시아에 단거리 탄도미사일 KN-23과 KN-24 100여 기와 이동식 발사대를 제공했으며, 전쟁이 길어지면서 북한산 미사일의 명중률도 향상됐다고 보았다.)

Amid this, it has been suggested that North Korean Foreign Minister Choe Son-hui, who officially visited Russia from the 18th to the 21st, may have discussed the issue of additional North Korean troop deployments. Russian President Vladimir Putin, during a meeting with Choe on the 19th (local time), "once again expressed gratitude to the North Korean leadership for their assistance in carrying out the special military operation (the war in Ukraine)," according to Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov. The following day, Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov also met with Choe and stated, "It is important for the secret communication between President Putin and North Korean Chairman Kim Jong-un to continue." (이런 가운데 지난 18~21일 러시아를 공식 방문한 최선희 북한 외무상이 북한군 추가 파병 문제 등을 논의했을 가능성도 제기된다. 블라디미르 푸틴 러시아 대통령은 19일(현지 시각) 최선희를 접견하는 자리에서 “특별군사작전(우크라이나 전쟁) 수행에 도움을 준 북한 지도부에 다시 한번 감사를 표했다”고 드미트리 페스코프 러시아 크렘린궁 대변인이 전했다. 이튿날 세르게이 라브로프 러시아 외무장관도 최선희를 만나 “푸틴 대통령과 김정은 북한 국무위원장의 비밀 소통이 계속되는 것이 중요하다”고 밝혔다.)

Kim Jong-un and Putin signed a mutual defense treaty during a summit in Pyongyang on June 19, 2024, and North Korea began deploying troops to Russia in October of that year. North Korea is estimated to have sent approximately 20,000 troops, including combat soldiers and engineers, to the Kursk region over four rounds so far. (김정은과 푸틴은 2024년 6월 19일 평양에서 열린 정상회담에서 동맹 조약을 체결했고, 북한은 그해 10월 러시아 파병을 시작했다. 북한은 지금까지 네 차례에 걸쳐 전투병과 공병 등 약 2만명을 쿠르스크 지역에 보낸 것으로 추정된다.)

item.title: 88% of Election Commission Staff Say Voting Tasks Should Be Transferred to Ministry of Interior and Safety (선관위 직원 88% “투표 업무 행안부로 넘겨야”)
item.description:
88% of Election Commission Staff Say Voting Tasks Should Be Transferred to Ministry of Interior and Safety (선관위 직원 88% “투표 업무 행안부로 넘겨야”)

About 90% of employees at the National Election Commission (NEC) agree that voting-related tasks should be handed over to the Ministry of the Interior and Safety (MOIS), according to a survey released on the 26th. Additionally, 40% of respondents believe that the early voting system should be completely abolished. The opposition party criticized this, stating, "The very idea of NEC employees shifting the voting duties—their reason for existence—to the executive branch is irresponsible." (선거관리위원회 직원의 90%가량이 투표 업무를 행정안전부로 넘겨야 한다는 의견에 동의하는 것으로 26일 나타났다. 사전 투표제를 전면 폐지해야 한다고 생각하는 견해도 전체의 40%에 달했다. 야당은 “선관위 직원들이 자신들의 존재 이유인 투표 사무를 행정부에 떠넘기겠다는 발상 자체가 무책임하다”고 지적했다.)

According to a survey report on "Organizational Reform and Election System Innovation" obtained by the office of People Power Party lawmaker Choi Bo-yoon, 88.5% (1,007 out of 1,138 respondents) of NEC employees supported transferring voting tasks to MOIS. Only 11.5% (131 respondents) favored maintaining the current system or other alternatives. (국민의힘 최보윤 의원실이 입수한 선관위 노조의 ‘조직 쇄신 및 선거 제도 개혁을 위한 설문조사 결과 보고서’에 따르면 전체 응답자 1138명 가운데 88.5%(1007명)가 투표 업무를 행안부에 이관하는 것에 찬성한다고 응답했다. 현행 유지 등 기타 의견은 11.5%(131명)였다.)

Regarding the abolition of early voting, 41.4% (474 respondents) supported full abolition, the highest response. This was followed by 30.2% (346 respondents) favoring "adjusting the early voting period or hours," and 21.8% (250 respondents) advocating for "replacing early voting with absentee voting." (사전 투표제 폐지에 대해서는 ‘전면 폐지’가 41.4%(474명)로 가장 많았다. 뒤이어 ‘사전 투표 기간이나 시간 조정’ 30.2%(346명), ‘사전 투표 대신 부재자 투표 도입’ 21.8%(250명) 순으로 나타났다.)

As priority measures to prevent a recurrence of the ballot paper shortage during the June 3 local elections (multiple responses allowed), respondents ranked "transferring voting tasks to MOIS (local governments)" (80.0%, 910 respondents) and "comprehensively overhauling the election system, including reforming early voting" (80.0%, 910 respondents) as top priorities. (6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 재발 방지를 위한 선행 조치(복수 응답)로는 ‘투표사무의 행안부(지방자치단체) 이관’(80.0%·910명), ‘사전투표제 개편 등 선거 시스템 전면 개편’(80.0%·910명)이 우선순위로 꼽혔다.)

Following these, "reviewing overall election management tasks" (72.6%, 826 respondents) and "adjusting unnecessary tasks that overload election management" (71.3%, 811 respondents) were cited. (다음으로 ‘선거 관리 업무 전반 재검토’(72.6%·826명), ‘선거 관리 업무에 과부하를 주는 불필요한 업무 조정’(71.3%·811명) 순으로 응답이 많았다.)

NEC employees identified the main causes of the ballot paper shortage as "lack of field applicability in the central committee's policy-making process" (54.8%, 624 respondents), "insufficient timely response from higher committees" (52.9%, 602 respondents), "decision to reduce supply due to storage burden of leftover ballot papers" (50.2%, 571 respondents), and "absence of a manual for responding to ballot paper shortages" (44.2%, 503 respondents). (선관위 직원들은 이번 투표용지 사태의 주요 원인으로 ‘중앙위원회 정책 수립 과정의 현장성 부족’(54.8%·624명), ‘상급위원회의 적시 대응 부족’(52.9%·602명), ‘잔여 투표용지 보관 부담에 따른 축소 결정’(50.2%·571명), ‘투표용지 부족 대응 매뉴얼 부재’(44.2%·503명) 등을 꼽았다.)

To enhance the NEC's transparency, 54.4% (619 respondents) preferred an "audit committee composed of external members and internal staff." Only 20.4% (232 respondents) favored an "audit committee under the National Assembly," and 12.8% (146 respondents) supported "direct audits by the Board of Audit and Inspection." (선관위 투명성 등을 높이기 위한 방안으로 응답자의 54.4%(619명)는 ‘외부위원 및 내부 직원으로 구성된 감사위원회’를 가장 선호했다. ‘국회 소속 감사위원회’ 20.4%(232명), ‘감사원 직접 감사’는 12.8%(146명)에 그쳤다.)

This survey was conducted anonymously by the NEC employees' union on an internal community platform from the 8th to the 16th of the month, over a nine-day period. The survey targeted 3,007 NEC employees nationwide (as of May), with 1,138 responding. (이번 조사는 선관위 공무원 노조가 지난 8일부터 16일까지 9일간 내부 커뮤니티에서 익명 투표 방식으로 실시했다. 조사 대상은 전국 선관위 현원 3007명(지난 5월 기준)으로 이 가운데 1138명이 답했다.)

item.title: Chung Seong-ho's resignation intent, but Lee remains silent… Ruling party says "It's because of the convention after all" (정성호 사의에도 李 침묵 계속… 여권 “결국 전대 때문”)
item.description:
Chung Seong-ho's resignation intent, but Lee remains silent… Ruling party says "It's because of the convention after all" (정성호 사의에도 李 침묵 계속… 여권 “결국 전대 때문”)

As Minister of Justice Chung Seong-ho recently expressed his intention to resign following the de facto confirmation of the abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigative powers, led by the Democratic Party of Korea, President Lee Jae-myung's silence on this issue is growing longer. Ruling party officials said, "President Lee has repeatedly emphasized his concerns about the abolition of supplementary investigative powers, but ahead of the Democratic Party's August 17 convention for party leader, where the sentiment of hardline party members is crucial, he seems to have no choice but to compromise." Consequently, it is anticipated that the revision bill of the Criminal Procedure Act will pass in the National Assembly plenary session this month, leading to the actual abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigative powers. <<> Minister Chung said to this paper on the 25th, "I haven't directly spoken to the president, but my intention to resign was previously communicated through Cheong Wa Dae aides," adding, "I have no more work to do or will to continue." He also stated, "It seems more meaningful to go to the party and take a central role." In the 'Collection of Best Practices for Prosecution Supplementary Investigations' published last year, Chung emphasized maintaining supplementary investigative powers, stating, "Errors or shortcomings in cases transferred from police after primary investigations should be corrected through additional investigations, without conducting new investigations." However, when the Democratic Party pushed for the abolition of supplementary investigative powers again early this year, led by hardline members of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, it was known that he conveyed his intention to resign from his ministerial post and return to the party. <<> It is said that Minister Chung again conveyed his resignation intention to Cheong Wa Dae after the Democratic Party confirmed the complete abolition of supplementary investigative powers as party policy on the 24th. A ruling party official said, "Minister Chung argued for the partial retention of supplementary investigative powers, saying 'there should be no 1% of victims who are unfairly treated,' but when this was ultimately not accepted, he effectively decided to step down, taking political responsibility." However, there is also a possibility that President Lee may reject his resignation, given the upcoming dissolution of the prosecution agency and the launch of the Public Prosecution Service and the Major Crimes Investigation Service in October. <<> Even as the ruling camp is divided over whether to keep or abolish supplementary investigative powers, President Lee, who is on a tour of the United States and South America, has not stated a clear position. In January, President Lee said, "It is right not to conduct supplementary investigations," but added, "There are exceptional cases where it is necessary," such as when the statute of limitations is imminent. In June, he said his position "has not changed." However, ahead of the recent Democratic Party convention, he indicated that he would leave the final decision to the National Assembly, saying, "The ruling party must also bear the responsibility accordingly." Since then, he has not issued any particular message even as the Democratic Party confirmed the complete abolition as party policy. <<> One of the reasons for President Lee's prolonged silence is cited as the possibility that, amid the ongoing Democratic Party convention, putting a brake on the abolition bill could provoke backlash from hardline supporters and affect the competition for party leadership. While all Democratic party leadership candidates officially support the complete abolition of supplementary investigative powers, candidate Chung Cheong-rae is evaluated as having stronger credentials for emphasizing the complete stripping of prosecution investigative powers since his tenure as party leader. Candidate Kim Min-seok, who said during his time as Prime Minister that "deliberation is necessary," announced on the 25th of last month, when the convention phase began in earnest, that "the abolition of supplementary investigative powers is the government's final position." <<> A Democratic Party official said, "Even if the president has different inner thoughts, on this issue of supplementary investigative powers, he cannot make moderate statements because of fear of hardline party members. So there's no choice but to abolish supplementary investigative powers as it stands. However, there are many opinions within Cheong Wa Dae and the government to first implement it and then, if problems arise, submit a revision bill again." Although the People Power Party argues that "the president must exercise his veto power," a Cheong Wa Dae official said, "There is no reason to reject a bill passed by the ruling party." <<> The Democratic Party leadership plans to bring the revision bill of the Criminal Procedure Act to the plenary session on the 30th, and if the opposition party initiates a filibuster, they will follow the procedures under the National Assembly Act to process the bill by the 31st. A leadership official said, "After finishing the review of the articles of the Criminal Procedure Act revision bill in the subcommittee of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee on the 27th and 28th, we plan to forward it to the full committee meeting of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee this week." <<> Meanwhile, the People Power Party has decided to engage in an all-out struggle against the bill abolishing supplementary investigative powers, including through a filibuster. People Power Party floor leader Chung Jeom-sik said in a Facebook post on the 26th, "If the president even gives up his power to request reconsideration (veto), from that moment on, the government and the ruling party will fall together. Betraying the country is not the only act of treason; betraying the people is also treason." Within the opposition, there were interpretations that "the 'ruling party-government rift' is becoming visible in the second year of the Lee Jae-myung administration" regarding Minister Chung's expression of resignation intention. (정성호 법무부 장관이 최근 더불어민주당 주도로 검찰의 보완수사권 폐지가 사실상 확정되자 사의를 표명한 가운데, 이 문제에 대한 이재명 대통령의 침묵이 길어지고 있다. 여권 관계자들은 “이 대통령이 보완수사권 폐지에 따른 우려를 수차례 강조해왔지만 강성 당원 표심이 중요한 민주당 8·17 전당대회 당대표 선거를 앞두고 어쩔 수 없이 타협을 택한 것 아니겠느냐”고 했다. 이에 따라 이달 내 국회 본회의에서 형사소송법 개정안이 통과되고 검찰의 보완수사권 폐지가 현실화할 것으로 전망된다.)

item.title: 'New Lee Jae-myung' parachuted in as association chairman… Appointment fails due to delegates' opposition (조합 이사장에 ‘뉴이재명’ 낙하산… 대의원들 반대로 선임 불발)
item.description:
'New Lee Jae-myung' parachuted in as association chairman… Appointment fails due to delegates' opposition (조합 이사장에 ‘뉴이재명’ 낙하산… 대의원들 반대로 선임 불발)

The Korea Specialty Contractors Financial Cooperative confirmed on the 26th that it had rejected the appointment of former lawmaker Lee In-ki, who left the People Power Party to support President Lee Jae-myung during the last presidential election, as its chairman. Although the cooperative is a private institution, its chairman has historically been drawn from bureaucrats or politicians. A political source commented, "Such positions are typically decided by higher-ups, so this likely reflects backlash against 'New Lee Jae-myung' personnel." (전문건설공제조합이 지난 대선 때 이재명 대통령을 지지하며 국민의힘을 탈당한 이인기 전 의원의 이사장 선임안을 부결시킨 것으로 26일 확인됐다. 전문건설공제조합은 민간 기관이지만 이사장은 통상 관료나 정치인 출신들이 맡아왔다. 정치권 관계자는 “이런 자리는 윗선에서 정하는대로 결정되기 마련인데 뉴이재명 인사에 대한 반감 아니겠냐”고 했다.)

The cooperative held a general meeting of delegates on the 23rd, conducting a vote on the appointment of former lawmaker Lee as chairman. The result was 38.5% in favor and 61.5% against. While the steering committee, composed largely of government-recommended members, had previously approved the appointment, an overwhelming majority voted it down. On the same day, the appointment of former Shinsegae Construction CEO Jeong Du-young as standing auditor was approved. Observers both inside and outside the cooperative noted, "It is highly unusual for a government-recommended candidate's appointment to fail." (전문건설공제조합은 지난 23일 대의원 총회를 열고 이 전 의원의 이사장 선임에 대한 찬반을 묻는 투표를 진행했다. 그 결과 찬성 38.5%, 반대 61.5%였다. 앞서 정부 추천 인사들이 다수로 구성된 운영위원회에선 찬성이 나왔지만 압도적인 부결표가 쏟아진 것이다. 이날 함께 진행된 정두영 전 신세계건설 대표이사에 대한 상임감사 선임안은 통과됐다. 조합 안팎에서는 “정권에서 추천된 후보의 선임이 불발된 건 매우 이례적”이라는 말이 나왔다.)

The Korea Specialty Contractors Financial Cooperative is a private institution providing financial services such as guarantees and loans to small and medium-sized construction companies. However, since the cooperative operates under the supervision of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, and Transport, political sources explain that the chairman has traditionally been appointed under the influence of the ruling party, including the presidential office and the Democratic Party. The current chairman is former People Power Party lawmaker Lee Eun-jae, appointed during the Yoon Suk Yeol administration. The chairman's term is three years, and the annual salary is reportedly around 300 million won. (전문건설공제조합은 중소·중견 건설 회사들에게 보증과 대출 등 금융서비스를 제공하는 민간 기관이다. 하지만 조합이 국토교통부의 감독을 받기 때문에 이사장은 청와대와 민주당 등 여권의 입김에 따라 정해져왔다는 게 정치권 관계자들의 설명이다. 현 이사장도 윤석열 정부 시절 선임된 이은재 전 국민의힘 의원이다. 이사장직 임기는 3년이고 연봉은 3억원 대로 알려졌다.)

The recommendation of former lawmaker Lee In-ki as a candidate for chairman was reportedly framed as a move for "integrated personnel appointments." Lee, a three-term lawmaker for the Grand National Party and the Saenuri Party, served as a co-chair of the Democratic Party's joint election committee during the last presidential election as part of the "New Lee Jae-myung" group. "New Lee Jae-myung" refers to the influx of centrist conservative figures who joined the Democratic Party during the last presidential election. (이번에 이인기 전 의원이 이사장 후보로 추천된 것은 통합 인사 명목으로 알려졌다. 한나라당과 새누리당에서 3선 국회의원 지낸 이 전 의원은 지난 대선 때 민주당 공동선거대책위원장을 지낸 뉴이재명 인사다. 뉴이재명은 지난 대선 때 민주당에 유입된 중도 보수 성향의 인사를 통칭한다.)

A source from the cooperative's steering committee said of the rejection, "It's a private institution funded entirely by member investments, but all past chairmen have been parachuted in. There was significant member backlash against this, effectively amounting to a revolt." Another cooperative official remarked, "It's extremely difficult to reject such an appointment, but some members opposed it because former lawmaker Lee is older and switched to the Democratic Party." (한 조합 운영위 관계자는 이 전 의원의 선임안 부결에 대해 “조합원 100% 출자로 구성된 민간 기관인데 역대 이사장이 모두 낙하산으로 내려왔다”며 “이에 대한 구성원들의 반발이 상당해 사실상 반란을 일으킨 것”이라고 했다. 다른 조합 관계자는 “부결되기 굉장히 어려운데, 조합원들 일부가 이 전 의원이 나이가 많고, 민주당으로 옷을 갈아입었다는 이유 등으로 반대를 했다”고 말했다.)

Within the Democratic Party, there was reportedly a sentiment favoring Democratic Party-affiliated candidates, with some asking, "Why give this position to someone from an opposition party instead of our side?" A steering committee source added, "With the construction industry already in a slump, and the government pushing laws like the Serious Accidents Punishment Act and the Yellow Envelope Act, there was a mood among members to 'not accept anyone installed by the current administration.'" It was reported that most of the votes in favor of former lawmaker Lee's appointment came from the Honam region, while opposition votes came from the Seoul and Gyeonggi metropolitan areas. (민주당 일각에선 “왜 우리 쪽 사람 대신 야당 출신에게 자리를 주냐”며 민주당 출신 인사를 후보로 미는 분위기도 있던 것으로 알려졌다. 운영위 관계자는 “건설 경기가 안 그래도 바닥인데, 정부가 중대재해처벌법과 노란봉투법 등을 밀어붙이면서 구성원들 사이에 ‘현 정부가 꽂은 인사는 받지 말자’는 분위기도 있었다”고 했다. 실제 이 전 의원 선임안에 대한 찬성표 대부분은 호남 지역에서 나왔고, 반대표는 서울·경기 등 수도권에서 나온 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: Kim: “Must Take Down All Anti-Myung” Jeong: “Claim of a Myung-Cheong Battle Is a Foolish Argument” (金 “반명 몽땅 떨어뜨려야” 鄭 “명청대전은 멍청한 주장”)
item.description:
Kim: “Must Take Down All Anti-Myung” Jeong: “Claim of a Myung-Cheong Battle Is a Foolish Argument” (金 “반명 몽땅 떨어뜨려야” 鄭 “명청대전은 멍청한 주장”)

Candidates for the Democratic Party of Korea’s leadership are intensifying their criticism of each other ahead of the first Chungcheong region primary on the 1st of next month. Candidate Kim Min-seok publicly branded pro-Chung (pro-Jeong Cheong-rae) supreme council candidates as “anti-Myung (anti-Lee Jae-myung)” on the 26th, stating, “Let’s take down all those who are pro-Myung in name but anti-Myung in reality and create a great party convention.” In response, Candidate Jeong Cheong-rae, targeting Kim, said, “Claiming there is a ‘Myung-Cheong battle’ is a foolish act,” adding, “I am the one who will protect President Lee.” <<> At a party member invitation lecture held at the Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology that day, Kim said, “Do you think the Democratic Party is a party that would appoint three anti-Myung candidates as supreme council members?” and “In the supreme council election to select the final five, the key point to watch is whether it goes 5 to 0.” He categorized three pro-Chung candidates—Lee Seong-yoon, Han Min-soo, and Choi Min-hee—among the eight who passed the preliminary primary (cutoff) on the 24th as anti-Myung, urging that the remaining five pro-Myung candidates be elected as supreme council members. At the event, pro-Myung supreme council candidates Park Seon-won, Kim Yong, Seo Mi-hwa, and Im Mi-ae were present together. Kim Min-seok said, “Those who view politics as arithmetic see the final result of the supreme council election as 3 to 2 (pro-Myung vs. pro-Chung),” but “you can make it 5 to 0.” <<> Kim also targeted Jeong, asking, “Are people who have said nothing but ‘no comment’ about anti-Myung forces qualified to be in the leadership?” This criticized Jeong’s recent response of “no comment” to Yoo Si-min’s daily direct attacks on President Lee’s governance, including terms like “rotten smell.” <<> Jeong denied the very existence of a Myung-Cheong battle. In an interview with Yonhap News released that day, he said, “The Myung-Cheong battle is like swinging at a nonexistent phantom or scarecrow.” Targeting pro-Myung figures who claim “If Jeong Cheong-rae succeeds in his re-election as party leader, President Lee’s lame-duck period will begin,” he added, “Those who attack like that and claim to be ‘pro-Myung’ are actually ‘anti-Myung’” and “Creating such fear and anxiety might be an election strategy, but it attacks President Lee as someone who would mess things up by being swept up by emotions.” He further claimed, “The President and I are one body.” <<> At a party member meeting held at the Ulsan City Party that day, Jeong referenced Kim’s history of leaving the Democratic Party ahead of the 2002 presidential election, saying, “I am confident that the person who will protect President Lee to the end is Jeong Cheong-rae, who has never betrayed the party or left it.” The three pro-Chung supreme council candidates also attended this meeting in a row. <<> Candidate Song Young-gil also targeted Jeong and other pro-Chung figures after visiting North Jeolla Province and meeting with party members, writing a Facebook post. Song wrote, “Will you fall into the dogma of reform, shake the President, and fail even at reform?” and “Reform that shakes the President while shouting slogans might earn applause from certain politicians, but it ends in election defeat and regime change.” He added, “I, Song Young-gil, who has proven loyalty to the President and putting the party before oneself through my life, will give the President wings.” <<> Over the weekend, candidates also clashed over the “Shincheonji intervention in the party convention” theory first raised by Kim Min-seok. Kim said, “The Shincheonji issue is not about whether it benefits or hurts me; I had no choice but to address it for the future of the party and South Korea.” It has been reported that Kim’s associates recently advised him to stop raising suspicions, noting that “if there is no clear link between Shincheonji and Candidate Jeong, it could backfire,” but Kim stated he would not weigh pros and cons. However, Jeong wrote on Facebook, targeting Kim, “Raising suspicions that could bankrupt the party must be met with severe disciplinary action to root out the chaos,” and added, “I hope the person who drove the party into chaos apologizes to party members, and the party takes strict measures.” (더불어민주당 당대표 후보들이 다음달 1일 첫 충청권 순회 경선을 앞두고 서로를 향한 비판 수위를 높이고 있다. 김민석 후보는 26일 공개적으로 친청계 최고위원 후보를 ‘반명(반이재명)’ 후보로 낙인찍고 “말로만 친명, 실제로는 반명하는 사람 몽땅 떨어뜨리고 위대한 전당대회를 만들자”고 했다. 반면 정청래 후보는 김 후보를 겨냥해 “‘명·청 대전’이 있다고 주장하는 것은 멍청한 짓”이라며 “이 대통령을 지킬 사람은 나”라고 했다.)

item.title: New leader of the Rebuilding Korea Party, Shin Jang-sik: “Open to unity with the Democratic Party… Rejecting hostile M&A-style approach” (조국혁신당 대표 신장식 “민주당과 통합 열려 있어… 적대적 M&A 방식은 거부”)
item.description:
New leader of the Rebuilding Korea Party, Shin Jang-sik: “Open to unity with the Democratic Party… Rejecting hostile M&A-style approach” (조국혁신당 대표 신장식 “민주당과 통합 열려 있어… 적대적 M&A 방식은 거부”)

The Rebuilding Korea Party has elected lawmaker Shin Jang-sik as its new party leader. In his acceptance speech, Shin stated, “I am open to discussions on solidarity and integration with the Democratic Party of Korea,” but added, “I firmly reject the hostile M&A (merger and acquisition)-style merger discussions being pursued by some in the Democratic Party.” Shin emphasized the need for the Rebuilding Korea Party—whose approval rating has stagnated at around 2-3% following former leader Cho Kuk’s failure to enter the National Assembly—to strengthen itself, and has pledged to field candidates nationwide in the 2028 general election. (조국혁신당이 신장식 의원을 신임 당대표로 선출했다. 신 대표는 수락 연설에서 “더불어민주당과의 연대와 통합 논의가 열려 있다”면서도 “민주당 일각의 적대적 M&A(인수·합병)식 합당 논의를 단호히 거부한다”고 했다. 신 대표는 조국 전 대표의 국회 입성 실패 이후 2~3%대 지지율에 그치고 있는 조국혁신당의 자강을 강조하며 2028년 총선 때 전국 곳곳에 자당 후보를 내겠다고 공약한 바 있다.)

The Rebuilding Korea Party held its party convention on the 25th and elected Shin, who ran unopposed in the leadership election, as its new leader with an overwhelming approval rate of 96.7%. This marks the first time since the party’s founding in 2024 that someone other than former leader Cho Kuk has been elected party leader. Lawmaker Cha Gyu-geun and former Secretary-General Hwang Hyun-seon were elected as supreme council members. (조국혁신당은 지난 25일 전당대회를 열고 96.7%의 압도적 찬성률로 당대표 선거에 단독 입후보한 신 의원을 당대표로 선출했다. 2024년 창당 이래 조국 전 대표 외의 인물이 당대표에 선출된 것은 이번이 처음이다. 최고위원에는 차규근 의원과 황현선 전 사무총장이 선출됐다.)

In his acceptance speech, Shin took a confrontational stance toward the Democratic Party. He criticized, “Is the current Democratic Party truly a reformist party?” adding, “It is delaying reforms in the prosecution, judiciary, politics, people's livelihoods, and overall societal change.” This was a jab at the recent internal debate within the Democratic Party over the abolition of the prosecution’s supplementary investigative powers. He stated, “I cannot trust the Democratic Party’s (reform) will,” and warned, “Anti-reform politicians who are hacking away at the pillar of prosecution reform should listen carefully. In the 2028 general election, the Rebuilding Korea Party will be the first to step up and judge them.” (신 대표는 수락 연설에서 민주당과 각을 세웠다. 그는 “지금의 민주당이 개혁 정당이 맞느냐”며 “검찰·사법·정치·민생 개혁과 사회 대개혁을 지체시키고 있다”고 비판했다. 검찰 보완수사권 폐지 문제와 관련해 최근까지 민주당 내 찬반 논란이 일었던 것을 겨냥한 것이다. 그는 “민주당의 (개혁) 의지를 믿지 못하겠다”며 “검찰 개혁의 기둥에 도끼질하는 반개혁 정치인은 똑똑히 들어라. 2028년 총선에서 조국혁신당이 가장 먼저 나서서 심판하겠다”고 했다.)

The Rebuilding Korea Party is expected to face key challenges regarding its party name change and the issue of merging or allying with the Democratic Party ahead of the 2028 general election. A party official commented, “As there are both pro-merger and opposition factions within the party regarding the Democratic Party, coordination will be quite difficult. Removing the name ‘Cho Kuk’ from the Rebuilding Korea Party will also not be easy.” (조국혁신당은 당명 개정과 2028년 총선을 앞두고 민주당과의 합당 및 연대 문제가 주요 과제가 될 것으로 보인다. 조국혁신당 관계자는 “당내 민주당 합당파와 반대파가 있기 때문에 이에 대한 조율이 상당히 어려울 것”이라며 “조국혁신당에서 ‘조국’이란 이름을 빼는 문제도 쉽지는 않을 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Lee Engages in 'Resource Diplomacy' with Three South American Nations (李, 이번엔 남미 3국서 ‘자원 외교’)
item.description:
Lee Engages in 'Resource Diplomacy' with Three South American Nations (李, 이번엔 남미 3국서 ‘자원 외교’)

President Lee Jae-myung, after a two-day visit to San Francisco in the United States, arrived in Brasilia on the 26th (local time) for a state visit to Brazil. President Lee is scheduled to visit Brazil from the 26th to the 29th, followed by an official visit to Chile from the 29th to the 30th. From the 30th to the 1st of next month, he will make an official visit to Argentina, then stop in Frankfurt, Germany, before returning home on the 3rd of next month. (이재명 대통령은 1박 2일간의 미국 샌프란시스코 방문을 마치고, 브라질 국빈 방문을 위해 26일(현지 시각) 브라질리아에 도착했다. 이 대통령은 26~29일 브라질 방문 후 29~30일 칠레를 공식 방문한다. 30일부터 다음 달 1일까지는 아르헨티나를 공식 방문하고, 독일 프랑크푸르트에 들러 다음 달 3일 귀국할 예정이다.)

Just before departing for Brasilia, President Lee posted on X (formerly Twitter), "Although geographically far apart, I have built a deep friendship with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva through several meetings over the past year." He also posted, "I look forward to meeting with President Javier Milei of Argentina with great anticipation and passion." <<> President Lee began his state visit on the afternoon of the 26th with a welcoming reception hosted by President Lula and his wife, and will hold an official summit with President Lula on the 27th. The two leaders have met three times: at the G7 summit in Canada last June, the G20 summit in South Africa last November, and President Lula's state visit to South Korea in February of this year. Bonding over their shared background as former child laborers, they have developed a friendly relationship. During President Lula's state visit to South Korea, President Lee presented gifts including a biography of the late activist Jeon Tae-il and an AI-generated video documenting the two leaders' journey from their childhood labor days to the present. <<> However, this visit to Brazil involves many considerations, including the political dynamics of the next destination, Argentina, and recent elections in South America. Currently, South American nations are engaged in intense political maneuvering ahead of Brazil's presidential election in October. Argentine President Milei recently attended a campaign rally for the right-wing bloc in São Paulo, Brazil, where he urged voters to support Flávio Bolsonaro, the eldest son of former President Jair Bolsonaro, who is a right-wing candidate in Brazil's election. President Lula is also clashing with U.S. President Donald Trump, who is seeking to expand his influence in Latin America by aligning with pro-American, right-leaning regimes. A source from the presidential office commented, "President Lee's decision to visit Argentina after Brazil is interpreted as an effort to avoid unnecessary misunderstandings." <<> The presidential office has stated it will focus on economic achievements during this South American tour. In a written interview with EFE news agency released on the 25th, President Lee said, "Mercosur member countries are global leaders in agriculture, food production, energy, and critical minerals, while South Korea is a global leader in advanced manufacturing, digital technology, shipbuilding, batteries, and innovation." He added, "By combining these strengths, we can build resilient value chains that benefit both regions." <<> President Lee plans to discuss resuming negotiations on a South Korea-Mercosur trade agreement with Brazil and Argentina, which lead Mercosur. He will also discuss modernizing the free trade agreement (FTA) with Chile, South Korea's first FTA partner. Key agenda items include supply chain cooperation in critical minerals, energy, and food. The plan is to strengthen economic security cooperation with Brazil, which is rich in rare earths and agricultural products; Chile, a major producer of copper and lithium; and Argentina, which holds shale gas and grain resources. <<> Accordingly, after his summit with President Lula, President Lee will travel to São Paulo, Brazil's economic hub. On the 28th, he will attend a Korea-Brazil Business Roundtable (BRT) event alongside an economic delegation, including Hyundai Motor Group Chairman Chung Eui-sun. Chairman Chung also accompanied President Lee on the San Francisco itinerary. (이 대통령은 브라질리아로 출발하기 직전 X(엑스·옛 트위터)에 “지리적으로는 멀리 떨어져 있지만, 루이스 이나시우 룰라 다시우바 대통령님과는 지난 1년 동안 여러 차례 만나며 깊은 우정을 쌓아왔다”고 썼다. “아르헨티나의 하비에르 밀레이 대통령님과의 만남을 큰 기대와 열정으로 기다린다”는 글도 올렸다.)

item.title: A $950 Billion 'Cheers' (9500억달러짜리 ‘건배’)
item.description:
A $950 Billion 'Cheers' (9500억달러짜리 ‘건배’)

President Lee Jae-myung, visiting the United States, stated on the 24th (local time) through the 'San Francisco AI Declaration' announced at the AI Summit, where global big tech CEOs in the artificial intelligence (AI) field and domestic business leaders gathered, that "South Korea will leap forward as a core country in the global AI supply chain." (미국을 방문한 이재명 대통령은 지난 24일(현지 시각) 인공지능(AI) 분야의 글로벌 빅테크 CEO들과 국내 기업 총수들이 모인 AI 서밋에서 발표한 ‘샌프란시스코 AI 선언’을 통해 “대한민국은 글로벌 AI 공급망의 핵심 국가로 도약할 것”이라고 했다.)

President Lee said that the key challenge of the AI era is the supply chain that connects technology, production, and the market, adding, "Based on the world's top-level memory semiconductor competitiveness and production capabilities, we will become a reliable AI semiconductor production base and supply chain partner." Regarding the 'Three Major Mega Projects' announced last month related to investments in semiconductors, data centers, and physical AI, President Lee stated, "This is a national-level supply chain safety device to sustain semiconductor production amid any crisis, and a responsible investment to prevent a global semiconductor shortage." (이 대통령은 이날 AI 시대의 핵심 과제는 기술과 생산, 시장을 연결하는 공급망이라며 “세계 최고 수준의 메모리 반도체 경쟁력과 생산 역량을 토대로 신뢰할 수 있는 AI 반도체 생산기지이자 공급망 파트너가 되겠다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 지난달 반도체, 데이터센터, 피지컬 AI 투자와 관련해 발표한 ‘3대 메가 프로젝트’에 대해 “어떤 위기 속에서도 반도체 생산을 지속하기 위한 국가 차원의 공급망 안전 장치이자, 글로벌 반도체 부족을 예방하기 위한 책임 있는 투자”라고 했다.)

Taking President Lee's visit to the U.S. as an opportunity, large-scale investment and cooperation plans between domestic companies and global big tech firms were also announced. Samsung Electronics and Broadcom signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) to pursue cooperation worth $200 billion (approximately 290 trillion won) in the memory and foundry sectors over the next five years. SK announced that it will push forward long-term semiconductor supply cooperation worth $750 billion (approximately 1,085 trillion won) with Nvidia and others over five years. (이 대통령의 미국 방문을 계기로 국내 기업과 글로벌 빅테크 기업의 대규모 투자·협력 추진 계획도 발표됐다. 삼성전자와 브로드컴이 향후 5년간 메모리·파운드리 분야에서 2000억달러(약 290조원) 규모 협력을 추진하는 양해각서(MOU)를 체결했고, SK는 엔비디아 등과 5년간 7500억달러(약 1085조원) 규모의 반도체 장기 공급 협력을 추진한다고 밝혔다.)

Naver decided to build a global AI factory worth $10 billion (approximately 14 trillion won) through an investment agreement with Nvidia and a supply contract with Brookfield. Hyundai Motor Group announced it would establish a standard-based platform for developing and validating AI robots with Nvidia, supporting robot development by universities and startups. President Lee described this as "a large-scale AI investment initiative, long-prepared by companies with a combined corporate value exceeding 2,000 trillion won." (네이버는 엔비디아와 투자 협약, 브룩필드와 공급 계약 등을 통해 100억달러(약 14조원) 규모 글로벌 AI 팩토리를 구축하기로 했다. 현대차그룹은 엔비디아와 함께 AI 로봇을 개발·검증할 수 있는 표준 기반을 구축해 대학·스타트업의 로봇 개발을 지원하기로 했다. 이 대통령은 “기업 가치 합계 2경 원이 넘는 기업들이 오랜 시간 준비해온 대규모 AI 투자 이니셔티브”라고 했다.)

On the 25th, President Lee met with major U.S. venture capital (VC) figures to request investments in Korean startups. President Lee said, "South Korea and the U.S. must expand the horizons of cooperation beyond the long-standing security alliance into a technology, innovation, and startup alliance," and combining U.S. venture investment capabilities with Korean technology, "let's create the next generation of Samsung, Hyundai, SK, and Naver." President Lee will then make a state visit to Brazil starting on the 26th. (이 대통령은 25일에는 미국의 주요 벤처캐피털(VC) 인사들을 만나 한국 스타트업 기업 투자를 요청했다. 이 대통령은 “한국과 미국은 오랜 안보 동맹을 넘어 기술·혁신·스타트업 동맹으로 협력 지평을 넓혀가야 한다”며, 미국의 벤처 투자 역량과 한국의 기술력을 결합해 “다음 세대의 삼성과 현대, SK, 네이버를 만들자”고 했다. 이 대통령은 이어 26일부터 브라질을 국빈 방문한다.)

item.title: "An Jung-geun's Theory of East Asian Peace Must Be Completed Through Korea-Japan Exchange" (“안중근 의사의 동양평화론, 韓日이 교류하며 완성시켜야”)
item.description:
"An Jung-geun's Theory of East Asian Peace Must Be Completed Through Korea-Japan Exchange" (“안중근 의사의 동양평화론, 韓日이 교류하며 완성시켜야”)

"I want to inform many people about the connection between the noble and highly cultured patriot An Jung-geun and eight Japanese individuals from Kochi Prefecture, as well as the role of a friendship monument reflecting on the future of Korea-Japan relations. Filling the gaps in An's unfinished posthumous work, the 'Theory of East Asian Peace,' is a task that we and the next generation must accomplish through exchange." (“고결하고 높은 교양을 지닌 안중근 의사와 8명의 고치(高知)현 출신 일본인들의 인연, 그리고 한일 관계의 미래를 생각하는 우호(友好) 기념비(碑)의 역할을 많은 사람들에게 알리고 싶습니다. 안 의사의 미완성 유고인 ‘동양평화론’의 공백을 메우는 것이 우리와 다음 세대가 교류하면서 해야 할 과제입니다.”)

Nishimori Shiozo (86), former chairman of the Kochi Prefectural Assembly in Japan, who will receive this year's Manhae Peace Prize, said in an interview with this newspaper, "As long as the Earth is not destroyed, Korea and Japan are eternal neighbors," adding, "There are no borders between the two countries, only the sea." He made these remarks. (올해 만해평화대상을 받는 니시모리 시오조(西森潮三·86) 전 일본 고치현 의회 의장은 본지와의 인터뷰에서 “지구가 파괴되지 않는 한, 한국과 일본은 영원한 이웃”이라며 “두 나라 사이에는 국경도 없고, 오직 바다만 있을 뿐”이라며 이같이 말했다.)

Former Chairman Nishimori became a recipient of the Manhae Peace Prize for his contributions over 30 years to promoting Korea-Japan friendship, including efforts to erect a monument honoring Japanese from Kochi Prefecture who were involved in An's trial and passed down his ideas to later generations. "When the 'Japan-Korea Friendship East Asian Peace' monument, unveiled last month, was dismantled in just six days, I felt as if I had fallen into hell. But receiving the Manhae Peace Prize feels like I've arrived in heaven," he said. (니시모리 전 의장은 안 의사와 그의 재판에 관여한 후 ‘안중근 사상’을 후대에 전해 온 고치현 출신 일본인을 기리는 기념비 건립 추진을 포함, 30여 년간 한일 우호 증진에 힘써 온 공로로 만해평화대상 수상자가 됐다. 그는 “지난달 제막한 ‘일한우호 동양평화(日韓友好 東洋平和)’ 기념비가 6일 만에 철거돼 마치 지옥에 떨어진 심정이었는데 만해평화대상 수상으로 천국에 온 것 같다”고 했다.)

After about a decade of effort, Nishimori held a monument unveiling ceremony last month on the grounds of the Kuroshio Hotel in Konan City, Kochi Prefecture. It drew significant attention, with about 80 figures from both Korea and Japan attending, including former Prime Ministers Kim Hwang-sik and Lee Nak-yon, House of Councillors member Hirota Hajime, and former and current members of the Kochi Prefectural Assembly. However, protest calls to the Kuroshio Hotel later led to the monument being temporarily dismantled and stored. Regarding the monument's re-erection last month, he stated, "I will not give up on what I have done for friendship between Kochi Prefecture and Korea. I will stake my life on it." (니시모리는 약 10년간의 노력 끝에 지난달 고치현 고난시(香南市)의 쿠로시오 호텔 부지에서 기념비 제막식을 개최했다. 김황식·이낙연 전 총리와 히로타 하지메 참의원 의원, 고치현 의회의 전·현직 의원 등 한일 양국 인사 80여 명이 참석할 정도로 큰 관심을 받았다. 그러나 이후 쿠로시오 호텔에 항의 전화가 걸려와 일단 기념비를 철거 후 보관 중이다. 그는 지난달 기념비 재건립과 관련, “고치현과 한국과의 우호를 위해 해 온 일을 포기하지 않겠다. 내 목숨을 걸고서 해 보겠다”고 밝힌 바 있다.)

Nishimori said, "An Jung-geun envisioned Japan abandoning its ambitions of aggression, cooperating with Korea and China to achieve peace in East Asia, and then realizing world peace based on that. Engraving 'East Asian Peace' on the monument was intended to accurately convey An's ideology." (니시모리는 ”안 의사는 일본이 침략의 야심을 버리고 한국, 중국과 협력해 동양 평화를 이룬 후 이를 바탕으로 세계 평화를 실현하자는 비전을 품었다“며 “기념비에 ‘동양평화’를 새긴 것도 안 의사의 사상을 정확히 전달하려는 의도였다”고 했다.)

Nishimori served as a member of the Kochi City Council for eight years and then as a member of the Kochi Prefectural Assembly for 32 years starting in 1983, serving as chairman twice. His interest in Korea-Japan relations began with a meeting with former Prime Minister Takeshita Noboru. (니시모리는 8년간 고치시 의회 의원을 거쳐 1983년부터 32년간 고치현 의회 의원으로 활동했다. 두 차례 의장도 역임했다. 그가 한일 관계에 관심을 갖게 된 계기는 다케시타 노보루(竹下登) 전 총리와의 만남이었다.)

"Meeting Prime Minister Takeshita, who was friendly toward Korea, changed my fate. Prime Minister Takeshita always said, 'Korea is a very important country to Japan,' and the Kochi Prefecture Japan-Korea Friendship Association was also operated based on his advice." (“한국에 우호적인 다케시타 총리와 만난 것이 운명을 바꿔 놓았습니다. 다케시타 총리는 늘 ‘한국은 일본에 매우 중요한 나라’라고 말씀하셨는데, 고치현 일한친선협회도 그의 조언을 바탕으로 운영됐습니다.”)

Nishimori deepened his involvement in Korea-Japan relations by leading efforts to erect a monument in Kochi Prefecture for Yoon Hak-ja (Japanese name: Tauchi Chizuko), who cared for 3,000 war orphans in Mokpo's Gongsaengwon after the Korean War. "After learning about Mrs. Tauchi through director Kim Soo-yong's film 'The Apocalypse of Love,' I proposed erecting a monument in Kochi Prefecture, where she was born, using stone from Mokpo. We built a cooperative system with Kochi's business community and media, launched a fundraising campaign, and raised 16 million yen." In June 1997, leading a Kochi-Japan friendship delegation and a group for establishing the Tauchi Chizuko monument, he visited the Jeollanam-do Provincial Government and also bowed his head, saying, "I apologize for the unfortunate history caused by Japan's colonial rule." (니시모리는 6·25 전쟁 후 목포 공생원에서 3000명의 전쟁 고아를 돌본 윤학자(일본명 다우치 치즈코) 여사 기념비를 고치현에 세우는 데 앞장서면서 한일 관계에 발을 깊숙이 내디뎠다. “김수용 감독이 만든 영화 ‘사랑의 묵시록’을 통해 다우치 여사를 알게 된 후, 목포의 돌로 그녀가 태어난 고치현에 기념비를 세우자고 제안했습니다. 고치현 경제계, 언론과 협조 체제를 구축하고 모금 운동을 벌여 1600만엔을 모았습니다.” 그는 1997년 6월 고치현 일한 우호 방문단과 다우치 치즈코 기념비 설립 모임을 이끌고 전라남도청을 방문, “일본의 식민지 지배가 초래한 불행한 역사를 사과한다”고 머리를 숙이는 일도 병행했다.)

These efforts led to the creation of a small memorial park featuring a 2-meter-high monument made from a 4-ton Mokpo raw stone donated by Yoon's son, Yoon Ki, chairman of Gongsaengwon. Subsequently, he contributed to sister port agreements between Mokpo Port and Kochi New Port, invitations for Korean baseball teams, and ultimately the signing of an exchange agreement between Jeollanam-do Province and Kochi Prefecture in 2016. (이 같은 노력으로 윤 여사의 아들 윤기 공생원 이사장이 기증한 4t 규모의 목포 원석으로 만든 높이 2m의 기념비가 설치된 작은 추모 공원이 만들어졌다. 이후에도 그는 목포항과 고치 신항의 자매 협정, 한국 야구팀 초청 등에 이어 2016년 전라남도와 고치현이 교류 협정을 체결하는 데 기여했다.)

Even after leaving politics, he actively took on the monument project proposed by former Prime Minister Kim Hwang-sik, chairman of the An Jung-geun Memorial Association. He judged it necessary to publicize that among those involved in An Jung-geun's trial in Lushun—including a judge, two prosecutors, two defense attorneys, a prison official, and a journalist (seven people in total)—and the person who transcribed the 'An Eung-chil History' and the unfinished manuscript 'Theory of East Asian Peace,' all came from Kochi Prefecture. Having been a prominent politician in Kochi Prefecture for 40 years, he persuaded the region's political, business, and media circles, successfully holding the unveiling ceremony for the 'Japan-Korea Friendship East Asian Peace' monument based on An's theory. (정계를 떠난 뒤에도 그는 안중근의사숭모회 이사장인 김황식 전 총리가 제안한 기념비 설립에 적극 나섰다. 안 의사가 뤼순에서 재판받을 때 재판관, 검찰관 두 명, 변호인 두 명, 형무소 간부, 기자 등 7명과 ‘안응칠 역사’와 미완성 유고 ‘동양평화론’을 필사해서 남긴 이도 고치현 출신이라는 것을 알릴 필요가 있다고 판단한 것이다. 40년간 고치현의 유력한 정치인으로 활동한 그가 지역의 정계·경제계·언론계를 설득, 안 의사의 동양 평화론에 기초한 ‘일한우호 동양평화’ 기념비 제막식을 가질 수 있었다.)

"An Jung-geun formed the Danji Alliance, cut off his finger, wrote 'Korean Independence' in blood, and then waged anti-Japanese activities. How can we view such a figure only through the lens of Japan as a victim? At the very least, such historical awareness is not suitable for future generations." (“안 의사는 단지동맹을 결성, 손가락을 자른 후 그 피로 ‘대한독립’을 쓴 후 항일운동을 전개했습니다. 그런데 그런 인물을 일본만 피해자 논리로 생각해서야 되겠습니까. 적어도 미래 세대에 이런 역사 인식은 적합하지 않습니다.”)

He stated, "Building stable relations in East Asia going forward will not be easy, as strategies of the United States, China, and Russia are also interwoven, but I hope that dialogue based on An Jung-geun's 'Theory of East Asian Peace' perspective will continue. I will spend the rest of my life leading efforts to learn history and make history." (그는 “앞으로 동아시아의 안정적인 관계 구축은 미국, 중국, 러시아의 전략도 얽혀 있어 쉽지 않지만 안 의사의 ‘동양평화론’적 시각에 기반한 ‘대화’를 계속해 나가길 바란다”며 “남은 생애를 역사를 알고 역사를 만드는 일에 앞장서겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee arrives in Brazil, inspects transport aircraft... Korea-Brazil summit tomorrow (李대통령, 브라질 도착해 수송기 시찰...내일 한·브라질 정상회담)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung arrived in Brazil's capital, Brasília, on the 26th (local time) after concluding his visit to the United States. President Lee is making a state visit to Brazil at the invitation of Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. (미국 방문 일정을 마친 이재명 대통령이 26일(현지 시각) 브라질의 수도 브라질리아에 도착했다. 이 대통령은 브라질의 루이스 이나시우 룰라 다시우바 대통령의 초청으로 브라질을 국빈 방문했다.)

On the 27th, President Lee is scheduled to hold a summit with President Lula in Brasília, followed by the signing of Memoranda of Understanding (MOUs), a joint press statement, and a state luncheon. (이 대통령은 27일 브라질리아에서 룰라 대통령과 정상회담을 갖고, 양해각서(MOU) 체결과 공동언론발표에 이어 국빈 오찬을 함께할 예정이다.)

The presidential office stated that ahead of this overseas trip, they expect to expand economic exchange and cooperation through the summit with Brazil, the hub of the South American economy, and to strengthen partnerships on critical minerals, especially with Brazil, a resource-rich nation. Brazil has the world's second-largest reserves of rare earths and is the top global exporter of coffee, sugar, and chicken. (청와대는 이번 순방에 앞서 남미 경제의 중심인 브라질과 정상회담을 통해 경제 교류·협력을 확대하고, 특히 자원 부국인 브라질과 핵심광물 파트너십도 강화될 것으로 기대된다고 했다. 브라질은 희토류 매장량이 세계 2위이고, 커피·설탕·닭고기 수출은 세계 1위다.)

President Lee has met President Lula four times since taking office. They met at the G7 summit in Canada in June last year, at the G20 summit in South Africa in November, and President Lula made a state visit to South Korea this past February. Following that summit, they held a "chimaek meeting" at the presidential office's Sangchunjae pavilion, featuring Korean-style fried chicken made with Brazilian chicken. In June, during the G7 summit in Évian-les-Bains, France, media captured President Lee and President Lula engaged in an extended conversation at the summit venue. (이 대통령은 취임 뒤 룰라 대통령과 네차례 만났다. 작년 6월 캐나다에서 열린 7국(G7) 정상회의, 11월 남아프리카공화국에서 열린 20국(G20) 정상회의에서 만났고, 지난 2월엔 룰라 대통령이 한국을 국빈 방문했다. 당시 정상회담에 이어 청와대 상춘재에서 브라질산 닭고기로 만든 한국식 치킨 등으로 ‘치맥 회동’도 했다. 지난 6월 프랑스 에비앙에서 열린 7국(G7) 정상회의에서도 이 대통령과 룰라 대통령이 정상회의장에서 한참 동안 대화를 나누는 모습이 언론에 포착되기도 했다.)

From their first meeting, Presidents Lee and Lula built a close rapport based on their shared background as "former factory boys" and similar political hardships. During the summit in February, President Lee referred to President Lula as a friend, comrade, and "amigo" (Portuguese for friend), saying, "I've often heard that our political journeys and life paths are quite similar," and added, "When people heard I was meeting President Lula, many congratulated us, calling it a 'meeting of former factory boys.'" (이 대통령과 룰라 대통령은 첫 만남 때부터 ‘소년공 출신’이라는 공통점, 비슷한 정치적 역경 등을 매개로 친분을 쌓았다. 이 대통령은 지난 2월 정상회담 때도 룰라 대통령을 친구, 동지, 아미고(amigo·포르투갈어로 친구)로 표현하면서 “정치적 여정, 인생 역정이 참 닮았다는 말을 자주 들었다”며 “룰라 대통령과 만난다고 하니 ‘소년공들의 만남’이라고 축하해주는 사람이 많았다”고도 했다.)

Meanwhile, after landing at the Brasília Air Force Base today, President Lee inspected the C-390 transport aircraft purchased by the South Korean Air Force from Brazil's Embraer. After examining the aircraft, President Lee stated, "This is significant as it marks the beginning of defense cooperation with Brazil," to which the Brazilian side responded, "We take great pride in working with South Korea, our most important partner in Asia." President Lee also met with and encouraged South Korean Air Force pilots and maintenance technicians receiving training on the transport aircraft locally, taking commemorative photos. (한편 이 대통령은 이날 브라질리아 공군기지에 착륙한 뒤, 우리 공군이 브라질 엠브라에르로부터 구매한 C-390 수송기를 시찰했다. 수송기를 둘러본 이 대통령은 “브라질과 국방 협력의 첫 시작이라 의미가 크다”고 했고, 브라질 측도 “아시아에서 가장 중요한 파트너인 대한민국과 함께해 매우 자부심을 갖는다”고 답했다. 이 대통령은 현지에서 수송기 운항 관련 교육을 받고 있는 우리 공군 조종사, 정비사들을 만나 격려하고 기념 촬영도 했다.)

Since the 24th, President Lee has been on an 11-day itinerary visiting the United States and three South American nations: Brazil, Chile, and Argentina. On the 28th, he will travel to São Paulo, Brazil's largest city and economic hub, to attend a luncheon meeting with overseas compatriots and a Korea-Brazil Business Roundtable event. Starting on the 29th, he will make an official visit to Chile, followed by an official visit to Argentina on the 30th. President Lee is scheduled to stop in Frankfurt, Germany, for a meeting with compatriots before returning home on the 3rd. (이 대통령은 지난 24일부터 미국과 브라질, 칠레, 아르헨티나 등 남미 3국 등을 방문하는 11일간의 순방 일정을 진행 중이다. 28일엔 브라질 제1의 도시이자 경제 중심지인 상파울루로 이동해 동포 오찬 간담회와 한·브라질 비즈니스 라운드테이블 행사에 참석한다. 29일부터는 칠레를 공식 방문하고, 30일에는 아르헨티나를 공식 방문한다. 이 대통령은 독일 프랑크푸르트에 들러 동포 간담회를 가진 뒤 3일 귀국할 예정이다.)

item.title: Pro-government figures dominated the 'rigged debate' that touched the 'detonator' of the president's approval rating (친정부 인사들이 마이크 장악한 ‘답정너 토론회’....대통령 지지율 ‘뇌관’ 건드렸다)
item.description:
In Korean society, real estate transcends the mere concept of an asset, serving as a core indicator that determines the quality of life and the future of the people. The public's view of the real estate policies recently introduced by the Lee Jae-myung administration is filled with distrust. The 'People's Grand Debate on Real Estate Policy,' presided over by the president himself on July 23, was intended to demonstrate a will to tackle the issue of skyrocketing real estate prices. However, it revealed numerous limitations and ultimately drew criticism, being labeled a 'Grand Real Estate Controversy.' (부동산은 한국 사회에서는 단순한 자산 개념을 넘어 국민적 삶의 질과 미래를 결정짓는 핵심 지표다. 최근 이재명 정부가 내놓는 부동산 정책을 바라보는 국민의 시선은 불신으로 가득 차 있다. 지난 7월 23일 대통령이 직접 주재한 ‘부동산 정책 국민 대토론회’는 부동산 폭등 문제를 잡겠다는 의지를 보여주려 했지만 수많은 한계를 드러내며 ‘부동산 대논란회’라는 지적을 받기에 이르렀다.)

There are four structural issues behind why this grand debate failed to gain public sympathy and faced criticism. (이번 대토론회가 국민적 공감을 얻지 못하고 비판에 직면한 배경에는 네 가지 구조적 쟁점이 자리 잡고 있다.)

First, there is a critical shortage of supply discussion. The most reliable key to market stability is supply. Currently, in Seoul and parts of Gyeonggi Province, new construction starts have sharply declined due to rising material costs and the worsening construction business conditions for builders. Despite market concerns dominated by supply shortages, the debate focused more on forcibly maintaining existing regulatory frameworks rather than presenting specific and effective supply measures. (우선 공급 논의의 심각한 태부족이다. 시장 안정을 위한 가장 확실한 열쇠는 공급이다. 현재 서울과 경기 일부 지역은 자재비 상승과 시공사들의 건설 경기 악화로 인해 신규 착공이 급감한 상태다. 공급 부족에 대한 우려가 시장을 지배하고 있음에도 토론회에서는 구체적이고 실효성 있는 공급 대책보다는 기존의 규제 틀을 억지로 유지하는 데 급급했다.)

There was no visible roadmap for easing regulations on redevelopment projects or developing new housing sites that residents of key hub areas like Gwacheon or Suwon could perceive, and alternatives to rescue stalled construction sites amid the aftermath of the construction industry restructuring were also inadequate. Fundamental alternatives, such as ways to lower construction costs to expand market supply, were not discussed. (과천이나 수원 등 주요 거점 지역 주민들이 체감할 수 있는 정비 사업 규제 완화나 신규 택지 개발 로드맵은 보이지 않았고, 건설 산업 구조조정 여파로 멈춰 선 현장들을 구제할 대안 역시 미비했다. 시장 공급 확대를 위해 건설 원가를 낮출 수 있는 식의 본질적인 대안은 논의되지 못했다.)

Second, there is an obsession with strengthening property holding taxes and a tax-centric approach. The government adhered to its existing stance of strictly raising tax standards for high-priced homes and multi-homeowners to curb housing prices, repeatedly maintaining the stance of "strengthening property holding taxes." Public opinion unanimously agreeing with these measures was extremely scarce. (둘째로 보유세 강화에 대한 집착과 세금 만능주의다. 정부는 고가 주택과 다주택자에 대한 과세 기준을 철저히 높여 집값을 잡겠다는 기존의 태도를 고수하며 “보유세를 강화하겠다”는 기조를 반복했다. 정부의 이러한 조치에 일방적으로 동의하는 여론은 극히 소수에 불과했다.)

Rather, the explosion of negative related terms such as 'serious problem,' 'side effects,' and 'inequality' regarding property holding taxes in the July 23 SomTrend big data <Figures 1 and 2> demonstrates that the public's perceived tax burden has reached a critical point. In particular, as even single-homeowners fall under the impact of the tax burden, preferred measures for a safe coexistence between landlords and tenants, or appropriate easing measures, were neglected. If taxes on homeowners are excessively raised, landlords will ultimately pass that burden onto tenants, inevitably driving up jeonse and monthly rent prices. (오히려 7월 23일 썸트렌드 빅데이터<그림 1·그림 2>에서 보유세와 관련해 ‘심각한 문제’ ‘부작용’ ‘불평등’이라는 부정적 연관어가 분출한 것은 국민들이 느끼는 세 부담 수준이 임계점에 달했음을 방증한다. 특히 1주택자들마저 세금 폭탄 영향권에 들어오면서, 임대인과 임차인 모두가 안전하게 상생할 수 있는 선호 조치나 적정 수준 완화 조치는 외면받았다. 주택 소유자들 세금을 과도하게 올리면 결국 임대인은 그 부담을 임차인에게 전가한다. 전·월세 가격이 오를 수밖에 없다.)

Third, there is a lack of solutions for jeonse loans for genuine home-seekers. Young, non-homeowners and ordinary people urgently need financial support to secure jeonse housing for immediate move-in, but due to the government's strict total loan regulations, the threshold for loans is completely 'restricted.' Related terms saw outcries of 'difficulty' and 'not easy' regarding housing mobility due to blocked loans, yet the government only emphasized the justification of loan regulation policies without offering targeted support measures for genuine home-seekers. During the debate, the government even revealed a perspective that dismissed the efforts of ordinary people to buy homes and build a stable life as mere speculative acts of 'using finance to make money,' which further fueled anger. (셋째는 실수요 전세대출 해결책의 부재다. 무주택 청년층과 서민들은 당장 입주할 전세를 구하기 위해 금융권의 도움이 절실하지만, 정부의 엄격한 총량 규제로 인해 대출 문턱은 완전히 ‘제한’에 걸리는 상태에 묶여 있다. 연관어로 대출이 막혀 주거 이동조차 ‘어렵다’ ‘쉽지 않다’는 비명이 터져 나왔으나, 정부는 대출 규제 정책 당위성만 피력하며 실수요자를 위한 핀셋 지원책을 내놓지 않았다. 토론회 과정에서 서민들이 주택을 사서 안정된 삶을 꾸리려는 노력을 그저 금융을 이용해 ‘돈 벌기 위한 수단’이라는 투기 행위로 치부하는 시선마저 드러나 부아를 돋웠다.)

Fourth, the bias of the debate participants is undeniable. Opposition parties or critical market experts who could candidly convey the field's desperate voices were thoroughly excluded. Instead, the debate was dominated by directors of state-run research institutes and pro-government figures, inviting criticism that it was a 'rigged, opinion-manipulating show.' Even when ordinary citizen panel participants complained about the harshness of loan regulations during the debate, the responses they received were merely lectures condemning home purchases as speculation. (넷째 토론회 참석자의 편향성을 의심하지 않을 수 없다. 현장의 절규를 가감 없이 전달할 야당이나 비판적 시장 전문가는 철저히 배제된 채, 국책연구기관 원장이나 친정부 성향 인사들이 주를 이루며 ‘답정너 여론몰이 쇼’라는 비판을 자초했다. 토론회 도중 일반 시민 패널 참가자들이 대출 규제의 가혹함을 호소했음에도, 돌아온 답변은 주택 구입을 투기로만 매도하는 훈계뿐이었다.)

Against this backdrop of the government's lack of policy realism, the trigger that dealt a decisive blow to trust in real estate policy was none other than the controversy over the extremely high mortgage lien set during the president's own sale of an apartment in Bundang. President and his recently sold an apartment in Bundang for 2.9 billion won while setting up a massive mortgage lien with a maximum bond amount of 1.77 billion won against the buyer. (정부 정책의 현실성이 이처럼 결여된 상황에서, 부동산 정책 신뢰 추락에 결정타를 날린 도화선은 다름 아닌 대통령 본인의 분당 아파트 매각 과정에서 불거진 초고액 근저당권 설정 논란이다. 대통령 부부는 최근 분당의 아파트를 29억원에 매도하면서, 매수인을 상대로 채권 최고액 17억7000만원에 달하는 대규모 근저당권을 설정했다.)

This employed an expedient known as 'seller financing,' where the seller directly lends the remaining balance to the buyer, who is completely cut off from bank loans. While this may not be illegal from the perspective of a private contract, there are criticisms that the president, who has tightly shut off the faucet of household loans, thus blocking the dreams of ordinary people to own homes, has himself potentially found a loophole around excessive loan regulations to reap enormous profits. (금융권 대출이 완전히 차단된 매수인에게 매도인이 직접 잔금을 빌려주는, 이른바 ‘셀러 파이낸싱’이라는 편법을 동원한 것이다. 물론 사적 계약 관점에서 위법은 아닐지라도 강력한 가계 대출 수도꼭지를 꽉 잠가 일반 국민의 내 집 마련 꿈을 차단해버린 채 정작 대통령 자신은 ‘과도한 대출 규제의 우회로를 찾아 막대한 이익을 얻어 갔을 수도 있다’는 지적이 나온다.)

The presidential office argues that this was "a transparent civil agreement for deferred payment and a normal transaction," but if an ordinary citizen had attempted a similar private financial transaction in a situation where loans are blocked, they would likely have become a target for tax audits or suspicions of speculation by investigative authorities. (청와대는 “잔금 유예를 위한 투명한 민사상 합의이자 정상적인 거래”라고 강변하지만 대출이 막힌 상황 속에서 일반 국민이 이와 유사한 사금융 거래를 시도했다면 당장 세무조사나 투기 혐의로 사정기관의 표적이 되었을 가능성이 있다.)

This distrust and disappointment are directly reflected in the recently released approval rating for the president's performance. In approval rating surveys, negative evaluations are continuously breaking new highs, and the primary reason cited for this is overwhelmingly 'failure of real estate policy,' ranking first. (이러한 불신과 실망감은 최근 발표된 대통령 국정 수행 지지율에 그대로 투영되었다. 지지율 조사에서 부정 평가는 연일 최고치를 경신하고 있으며, 그 구체적인 이유의 핵심으로 ‘부동산 정책 실패’가 압도적 1위를 기록하고 있다.)

In a survey conducted independently by Gallup Korea from July 21 to 23 (nationwide, 1,003 people, wireless virtual number telephone interview, sampling error 95% confidence level ±3.1%p, response rate 10.7%; details can be verified on the survey institute's website or the National Election Survey Deliberation Committee website), respondents who negatively evaluated the president's job performance cited 'real estate policy' (22%), 'economy, livelihood, high exchange rate' (10%), 'general incompetence' (7%), 'moral issues/avoiding personal trial' (5%), 'reduction of prosecution power', 'corruption, election rigging, election commission issues', 'national defense/security', and 'dictatorship/arbitrariness' (each 4%) as reasons. Real estate was the highest-ranked reason for negative evaluation. (한국갤럽이 자체적으로 지난 7월 21~23일 실시한 조사(전국1003명 무선가상번호전화면접조사 표본오차95%신뢰수준±3.1%P 응답률10.7% 자세한 사항은 조사 기관의 홈페이지 또는 중앙선거여론조사 심의위원회 홈페이지에서 확인 가능)에서 대통령 직무 수행 부정 평가자는 그 이유로 ‘부동산 정책’(22%), ‘경제·민생·고환율’(10%), ‘전반적으로 잘못한다’(7%), ‘도덕성 문제·본인 재판 회피’(5%), ‘검찰 권한 축소’, ‘부실·부정선거·선관위 문제’, ‘국방·안보’, ‘독재·독단’(이상 4%) 등을 이유로 들었다. 부동산이 부정 평가 이유로 가장 높았다.)

In big data analysis reflecting public sentiment, the public's view of real estate policy is marked by extreme words like 'damage' and 'riot.' Behind the public turning its back on the administration lies not just resentment over rising home prices, but a deep sense of betrayal that the morality and consistency of policy have completely collapsed. This is because they have witnessed the unequal reality where non-homeowners, trapped in the snare of strict regulations and unable to secure jeonse deposits, are being driven out of the housing ladder, while the president perfectly preserves asset value through a private finance loophole. (대중의 감성 반응을 보여주는 빅데이터 분석에서도 부동산 정책을 향한 대중의 시선은 ‘피해’와 ‘폭동’ 같은 과격한 단어로 얼룩져 있다. 국민이 정권에 등을 돌린 배경에는 단순히 집값이 오른 것에 대한 원망을 넘어, 정책의 도덕성과 일관성이 완전히 무너졌다는 배신감이 짙게 깔려 있다. 강력한 규제의 덫에 갇혀 전세금을 구하지 못해 주거 사다리 밖으로 내몰리는 무주택 서민이 속출하는 마당에, 사금융 형태의 우회로로 자산 가치를 완벽히 보전하는 불평등한 현실을 목도했기 때문이다.)

Experts are successively diagnosing that the current surge in apartment prices and the disappearance of jeonse and monthly rental listings, mainly in the Seoul metropolitan area, is more severe and worsened than during the Moon Jae-in administration, which was considered to have historically failed in real estate policy. Regulations are breeding more regulations, paralyzing the market supply chain, and causing prices to soar uncontrollably. (현재 수도권을 중심으로 나타나는 아파트 가격의 폭등과 전월세 매물 잠김 현상은 과거 역대급 부동산 정책 실패로 평가받던 문재인 정부 시절보다 더 심각하고 악화된 상태라는 전문가들의 진단이 잇따르고 있다. 규제가 또 다른 규제를 낳고 시장의 공급망을 마비시키면서 가격은 천정부지로 솟구치고 있다.)

To prevent this catastrophe, what is needed is not makeshift opinion manipulation, but a complete paradigm shift toward market-friendly policies. (이 파국을 막기 위해서는 임시방편식 여론몰이가 아니라 시장 친화적인 정책 패러다임의 전면 대전환이 필요하다.)

It is being proven once again that policies that defy the principles of the market for political purposes will ultimately return as greater disasters and boomerangs. In a regulatory omnipotence so messed up that even the president cannot sell a home through normal means and must find a loophole, the suffering of ordinary people is intensifying. What the government needs now is a humble admission of failure and the courage to boldly abolish anti-market regulations.
